sentences.text: Across the five tabular benchmarks, Fernwood achieved a slightly higher mean test AUROC (80.6) than Quillgate-GBDT (80.3), a difference of 0.3 points for which no significance test was reported.

Per benchmark, Fernwood outperformed Quillgate-GBDT on Alder-Credit (82.1 vs 80.4), Birchfield-Churn (87.3 vs 86.0), and Edgerton-Default (70.2 vs 67.8), but underperformed on Cobalt-Insure (72.1 vs 73.9) and Dunmore-Fraud (91.1 vs 93.5).
Fernwood's mean AUROC (80.6) also exceeded Mesh-MLP's (78.3), and Fernwood was higher than Mesh-MLP on all five benchmarks individually.
